{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
crm = completed_data.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract conversion rates
email_rate = crm['email']
paid_search_rate = crm['paid_search']

# Compute difference (email - paid_search)
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
